subject: Dedicated capacity pricing follow-up — GPU type, reserved size, throughput targets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's call — dedicated capacity pricing

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Below is a short recap of what we discussed and the items we need to finalize pricing for a Dedicated capacity proposal. Please confirm or correct any of the numbers so we can produce a tailored quote.

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: Clinical notes summarization + patient triage assistant (server-side inference, mix of short prompts + longer context responses).
- Target SLA: P95 latency target for interactive flows ~300ms; batch jobs can be higher.
- Preferred models: open-chat family; planning to evaluate a 70B chat-class model initially.

Info we requested (please confirm):
- Estimated monthly token volume (prompt + completion): ~1.2 billion tokens / month (you mentioned 1-1.5B).
- Peak concurrency / throughput: estimated peak concurrent requests ~60; average response size ~150 tokens.
- Latency SLO: P95 <= 300ms for interactive user flows.
- Preferred GPU families: you mentioned H100 as preferred; A100 is acceptable if cost-driven.
- Target budget range for Dedicated reserved capacity: $20k–$40k / month (you indicated mid-20k target for pilot).
- Unit economics target: target price roughly $18–$22 per 1M tokens (goal for internal cost planning).

Attachments: I attached a quick dedicated-pricing-worksheet that maps token volumes to reserved configurations and ballpark monthly costs.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token range you expect for Q3 (low / expected / high)?
2) Confirm preferred GPU (H100 vs A100) and whether redundancy is required across zones.
3) Marcus and Aditya will propose 2 recommended reserved configurations (pilot + production) and share expected $/1M token numbers and throughput assumptions.

If it helps, we can do a 30min follow-up tomorrow to walk through the worksheet.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
--Attachment: dedicated-pricing-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's call — dedicated capacity pricing

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary — this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications / numbers from our side:
- Monthly tokens (best estimate): low 800M, expected 1.2B, high 1.8B. The bulk is completions; prompts are ~25% of total tokens.
- Peak concurrency: we see bursts up to ~80 concurrent inference sessions during business hours; typical sustained concurrency ~25-40.
- Avg response size: ~150 tokens (some flows 300+ tokens for detailed summaries).
- Latency SLO: yes, P95 <= 300ms is our goal for UI interactions. For background batch jobs latency can be relaxed.
- GPU preference: we'd like H100 if pricing works; otherwise A100 is fine for initial pilot.
- Budget: for pilot we can get internal approval in the $18k–$28k/month range. Production (post-prove) could be $30k–$60k/month depending on tradeoffs.
- Target unit cost: we'd like to be at or under $22 / 1M tokens once batching/caching is in place.

We are happy for your team to propose 2 configuration options (pilot vs production). Also please include assumptions about model size and quantization (if relevant), and expected utilization (hours/day).

Daniel
Director, Product
Acme Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + next steps — please size Dedicated configs

Thanks — I drafted two realistic options based on Daniel's ranges and our internal benchmarks. Short version first, details below.

Option A — Pilot (cost-conscious, meet pilot budget):
- Config: 2 x H100 (reserved), single AZ, shared routing with burst capacity to spare.
- Expected sustained throughput: ~45-60k tokens/s aggregate across both GPUs (varies by model and quantization).
- Monthly capacity (ballpark): supports ~1.3-1.6B tokens/month with efficient batching and prefix caching.
- Estimated monthly cost (Redwood Dedicated): ~$24k / month.
- Estimated unit economics: ~ $17- $20 / 1M tokens after expected batching/caching gains.
- Notes: Good fit for Daniel's pilot budget (~$18k-28k). H100 gives best latency for interactive flows; recommend enabling reduced-precision quantization for cost efficiency if model compatibility allows.

Option B — Production (headroom + redundancy):
- Config: 4 x A100 or 3 x H100 (preferred) across two AZs for redundancy.
- Expected sustained throughput: ~100-140k tokens/s aggregate (depends on model); headroom for spikes up to 200k tokens/s with autoscale bursts.
- Monthly capacity (ballpark): 2.5-3B tokens/month comfortably.
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$38k- $48k / month depending on GPU mix and redundancy.
- Estimated unit economics: ~ $12- $18 / 1M tokens (production optimizations, higher utilization, and caching drive down effective $/1M).
- Notes: If Acme prioritizes cost over lowest latency, A100 (4x) is more cost-efficient; H100 cluster gives better latency for the interactive SLO. Include multi-AZ for resilience.

Assumptions / caveats:
- Model: numbers assume a 70B chat model, FP16 or Q4 quantization path — exact throughput varies by model family.
- Utilization: pilot assumes ~60% utilization during business hours and burst autoscale for peaks. Production assumes 75-85% effective utilization.
- Throughput estimates are for server-side batched inference and include KV cache benefits for repeated prefixes.
- We can tighten the estimate if Daniel shares a sample traffic trace (per-route qps and request token histogram).

Next steps I propose we share this summary with Daniel, include the filled dedicated-pricing-worksheet and propose a short follow-up to pick config. Happy to jump on a call with their infra team to validate concurrency/latency tradeoffs.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
--Attachment: SLA-draft.pdf (pdf, 24KB)

- Production recommendation: 3 x H100 (preferred) or 4 x A100 (cost alternative) across two AZs — estimated $38k- $48k/month with better headroom and multi-AZ resilience; expected unit cost ~ $12- $18 / 1M tokens.

Action items / next steps:
1) Daniel: confirm which configuration aligns with your pilot approval band (pilot <= $28k) — if yes, we will prepare a formal Dedicated quote and a 30-day reserved commitment sheet.
2) Daniel: share a short traffic sample (CSV or CSV export from your proxy) if you can — this helps Marcus dial-in throughput and queuing assumptions.

Would you be available for a 30min call tomorrow to finalize pilot vs. production choice and timing? If so, propose 9:30am or 2:00pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
